description: Sudden severe abdominal pain; admitted through emergency and operated for acute appendicitis.
scenario: Covered surgery with room-rent cap, consumables exclusion, deductible and co-pay

description: Planned surgery for progressive blurring of vision in the left eye.
scenario: Cataract inside the 24-month specified-disease waiting period

description: High fever and breathlessness; admitted to ICU with pneumonia.
scenario: Early claim, 94% of sum insured, claim form amount differs from the bill total

description: Admitted for dengue fever with low platelet count.
scenario: Discharge summary missing

description: Fracture of right forearm after a fall at home.
scenario: Incident before 2025-04-01, so the 2024.1 wording applies

description: Claim for hospitalisation for appendicitis.
scenario: Duplicate of CLM-H-1001

description: Rear-ended at a traffic signal on Outer Ring Road; rear bumper, boot lid and tail lamp damaged.
scenario: Depreciation by part type and vehicle age, plus compulsory deductible

description: Vehicle hit the road divider late at night; front bumper and bonnet damaged.
scenario: Driving under the influence exclusion (clause 3.1)

description: A fire started in the kitchen after an electrical short circuit; the kitchen, part of the living room and several appliances were damaged.
scenario: Fire loss with contents depreciation and the average clause for underinsurance (2.3)

description: The house was broken into while the family was away for the weekend; the rear door lock was forced and electronics and jewellery were stolen.
scenario: Burglary: unscheduled jewellery not covered (3.5), depreciation on electronics, excess

description: Damp patches and peeling plaster were noticed on the bedroom wall and ceiling after the monsoon.
scenario: Seepage and gradual deterioration exclusion (3.1)

description: Severe abdominal pain during a business trip; admitted through emergency and operated for acute appendicitis.
scenario: Emergency surgery abroad: personal comfort items not payable (2.4), deductible

description: Checked suitcase did not arrive at London Heathrow and was declared lost by the airline after 21 days.
scenario: Lost baggage: per-item limit and per-trip baggage limit (2.3)

description: Injured in a paragliding accident near Interlaken; fractured left ankle and treated in hospital.
scenario: Hazardous sports exclusion (3.2)

description: Checked baggage was lost on arrival at Dubai; the airline has not traced it.
scenario: Baggage claim without the airline's property irregularity report (5.2)

description: Admitted at full term and delivered by caesarean section.
scenario: Maternity and childbirth exclusion (4.4)

description: Skidded on a wet road and hit a parked truck; front bumper, bonnet and headlamp damaged.
scenario: Driver without a valid licence exclusion (3.2)

description: The house was broken into and electronics were stolen while the family was abroad; it had been unoccupied since early June.
scenario: Unoccupied premises exclusion (3.3)

description: Chest pain in Toronto; admitted to hospital for a known heart condition that was under treatment before departure.
scenario: Pre-existing condition exclusion (3.1)

description: Planned nose surgery for appearance.
scenario: Cosmetic surgery exclusion (4.1)

description: Fell at a party and hit his head; brought to emergency.
scenario: Alcohol and intoxication exclusion (4.2)

description: Admitted for a stem cell therapy session for knee pain.
scenario: Experimental treatment exclusion (4.5)

description: High fever for five days; admitted for typhoid.
scenario: Illness inside the 30-day initial waiting period (3.1)

description: Known case of type 2 diabetes declared at proposal; admitted with an infected foot ulcer.
scenario: Pre-existing disease inside the 36-month waiting period (3.2)

description: Engine seized while driving on the highway; no collision.
scenario: Wear, tear and mechanical breakdown exclusion (3.3)

description: Collision with a bus while driving in Nepal on a road trip.
scenario: Use outside India exclusion (3.4)

description: Front-end collision with a stalled tractor at night.
scenario: Engine above 1500cc: INR 3,500 deductible (2.3) after depreciation

description: Windscreen smashed and doors scratched by unknown persons in a parking lot; malicious damage.
scenario: Malicious damage without a police report (4.1)

description: Fire in the living room damaged the furniture and walls.
scenario: Wilful act exclusion (3.2)

description: Lightning struck the house and the fire that followed destroyed most of the building.
scenario: Loss above the sum insured: capped at the sum insured (1.2)

description: Roof and windows damaged by cross-border shelling.
scenario: War and nuclear risks exclusion (3.4)

description: Fell from a hotel balcony while intoxicated after a party; wrist fractured and treated in hospital.
scenario: Alcohol and drugs exclusion (3.3)

description: Travelled against medical advice two weeks after heart surgery; admitted to hospital with complications.
scenario: Travel against medical advice exclusion (3.4)

description: Severe food poisoning in Paris; admitted to hospital overnight.
scenario: Medical claim abroad without the treating doctor's report (5.2)

description: Planned surgery for a right inguinal hernia.
scenario: Hernia after the 24-month specified-disease wait (3.3): deductible and co-pay

description: High fever with bleeding gums; admitted to the ICU with severe dengue.
scenario: ICU charged above the INR 10,000 per-day limit (2.3)

description: Two-wheeler road accident; fracture of the right tibia.
scenario: Accident 11 days into cover: the 30-day initial wait does not apply (3.1)

description: Known case of hypertension declared at proposal; admitted with a hypertensive urgency.
scenario: Pre-existing disease after the 36-month wait (3.2), room-rent cap, consumables

description: High fever for four days; admitted for viral fever.
scenario: Admission after the policy lapsed on 2025-06-30 (2.1)

description: Side-swiped by a reversing truck in a parking lot; front door, side mirror and window glass damaged.
scenario: Car over 5 years old: 40% depreciation on metal parts (2.2)

description: Car parked in the basement was submerged when flood water entered during heavy rain.
scenario: Flood damage (2.1) with depreciation for a car 29 months old

description: Rear-ended by a bus at a junction; rear bumper, boot lid and tail lamp damaged.
scenario: Car under 6 months old: no depreciation on metal (2.2); 1598cc deductible (2.3)

description: Windscreen smashed and a door dented by unknown persons during a street protest; malicious damage.
scenario: Malicious damage with the police report (4.1): glass without depreciation

description: The outlet pipe of the overhead water tank burst suddenly and flooded the ground floor.
scenario: Burst pipe (2.1): contents depreciation and excess, adequately insured

description: Cyclone winds tore off roof sheets, brought down the compound wall and damaged the air conditioner outdoor unit.
scenario: Cyclone loss with the average clause for underinsurance (2.3)

description: An earthquake cracked the walls and ceiling and toppled a cabinet and the television.
scenario: Earthquake (2.1): contents depreciation and excess

description: Trip cut short after the death of the insured's father in India; returned early on 2025-10-15.
scenario: Trip cut short by a family death (2.2), within the cancellation limit

description: Sudden chest pain in New York; admitted and treated for a heart attack.
scenario: Large emergency medical claim abroad (2.1): comfort items and deductible only

description: Checked suitcase did not arrive in Sydney and was declared permanently lost by the airline.
scenario: Lost baggage inside the per-item and per-trip limits (2.3)

description: Scooter accident in Bali; fractured right collarbone, taken to hospital by ambulance.
scenario: Accidental injury abroad (2.1) with an ambulance: comfort items and deductible

description: Slipped on a wet staircase at the office and fractured the right ankle.
scenario: Weekly benefit capped at INR 10,000 a week (2.4); medical expenses within 10% (2.5)

description: Right index finger crushed in a press machine accident at the workshop.
scenario: Index finger is 10% of the sum insured in the disablement table (2.3)

description: The insured, Imran Sheikh, was killed when a truck hit his motorcycle on the highway.
scenario: Accidental death: 100% of the capital sum insured to the nominee (2.1)

description: Hospitalised with dengue fever and unable to work for three weeks.
scenario: Dengue is an illness, not an accident (1.3)

description: Car hit a road divider late at night; the insured was driving home from a party.
scenario: Injury while drunk: excluded (3.2)

description: Fell from a first-floor balcony at home; spinal cord injury with paralysis below the waist.
scenario: Full sum insured claimed 45 days after cover began: high risk, sent to investigation

description: Fell from a ladder while repairing the roof and fractured the left wrist.
scenario: Treating doctor's certificate not submitted (4.2)

description: The life assured died of a heart attack at home.
scenario: Death six years into the policy: sum assured paid in full (2.1)

description: The life assured died of advanced stomach cancer.
scenario: Death 17 months into the policy, inside the three-year section 45 period (3.2): investigated

description: The life assured was found dead at home.
scenario: Suicide eight months after commencement: excluded (3.1)

description: The life assured died after a long period of depression.
scenario: Suicide 55 months after commencement: the 12-month exclusion no longer applies (3.1)

description: The life assured died in hospital after a stroke.
scenario: Death certificate not submitted (4.2)

description: The life assured died of kidney failure.
scenario: Death on 2025-07-20, after the ten-year term ended on 2025-05-31 (1.3)
